observations: Landing canonical remains hard-coded to https://join.onetimeonetime.com/.
APP_VERSION and COMMIT_SHA default to local and are exposed by /version.
No ALLOWED_HOSTS or canonical-host enforcement setting is present in the audited config.
No Railway healthcheck request-host exception is present because no production host allowlist exists in the audited composition.
The server has 301 legacy path redirects for /one-time, /one-time/signup, and /rabbi-member.
The server includes login and protected owner, parent, and student application routes.
The audited branch declares email sender and reply-to variables but leaves values unset.
Real email, WhatsApp, Telegram, and payment transport flags remain false and non-test activation is rejected by config.
Vimeo credentials and a Vimeo webhook secret name are declared, but a public Vimeo callback route was not proven in the audited application composition.
The internal OT-86 publication endpoint is not a substitute for a provider callback inventory.
The public-page build uses one landing canonical for all generated pages and does not generate robots.txt or sitemap.xml in the audited script.
